skill_name: Summarize the implications of a highly automated economy.
workflow: The implications of a highly automated economy are far-reaching, from job displacement to inequality in access to resources and wealth. Automation will likely lead to fewer jobs, and will likely disproportionately affect lower-income workers with less access to technology and training to keep up with these changes.
